title: Five for the Future: Giving Back 5% to WordPress
content:
Did you know… 🤓

…WordPress asks companies that profit from it to give back 5% of their resources?

It's called Five for the Future: businesses sponsor developers, designers, and support staff to spend part of their work week contributing directly to WordPress, instead of just relying on volunteers.

Hosting companies, agencies, and plugin makers all take part this way, sponsoring contributors across dozens of make.wordpress.org teams to help keep WordPress moving forward.
